# StaffTraveler Blog

> > The StaffTraveler blog is the essential resource for airline employees navigating non-rev standby travel, featuring destination guides, connectivity solutions, and aviation industry insights.

StaffTraveler serves over one million airline staff worldwide with tools and content for standby travel. The blog covers practical non-rev travel tips, destination guides, layover advice, and introduces products like the StaffTraveler eSIM for global connectivity.

## Key Topics

- Non-rev travel
- Standby travel
- Airline employees
- StaffTraveler app
- eSIM connectivity
- Travel guides
- 24-hour city itineraries
- Flight attendants
- Female pilots
- Budget travel
- Layover tips
- Aviation community
- Mobile data roaming
- Instagram travel influencers
- Airline staff benefits

## Non-Rev Travel Essentials

- [10 Simple Rules for Non-Rev Travel](https://blog.stafftraveler.com/travel/10-rules-for-non-rev-travel): Essential tips for stress-free non-rev standby travel for airline staff
- [Join Forces to Create the Ultimate Non-Rev Airline Notes: Share Your Insights!](https://blog.stafftraveler.com/stafftraveler/create-airline-notes): Community call to contribute airline-specific non-rev travel insights
- [How to Get the Most Out of Your Travel Budget](https://blog.stafftraveler.com/travel/how-to-get-the-most-out-of-your-travel-budget): Budget travel tips for maximizing weekend getaways and affordable trips
- [LAX: Tips for your next layover](https://blog.stafftraveler.com/travel/lax-layover): Practical tips for conquering long layovers at LAX airport
